title: Industrial Silo & Concrete Form Construction, 1960s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A mid-20th century black and white square snapshot documenting a large-scale industrial or agricultural construction site. On the left, a massive curved wooden form panel hangs suspended from invisible crane cables against the sky. To the right, a tall cylindrical structure composed of metal rebar framework and concrete formwork is assembled on the excavated earth, with a solitary construction worker standing alongside it at the base for scale.
